queries.sql: select s.name as name, cast((select top 1 ep.value from sys.extended_properties ep where ep.class = 3 and ep.major_id = s.schema_id and ep.minor_id = 0 and ep.name = ?) as nvarchar(4000)) as comment, (select count(*) from sys.objects o where o.schema_id = s.schema_id and o.type in (?, ?) and o.is_ms_shipped = 0) as table_count from sys.schemas s where s.name not in (?, ?, ?) and s.schema_id not between 16384 and 16399 order by s.name collate latin1_general_bin2

select top (?) o.name as name, o.type as obj_type, cast((select top 1 ep.value from sys.extended_properties ep where ep.class = 1 and ep.major_id = o.object_id and ep.minor_id = 0 and ep.name = ?) as nvarchar(4000)) as comment, case when o.type = ? then (select sum(p.rows) from sys.partitions p where p.object_id = o.object_id and p.index_id < 2) end as row_count from sys.objects o join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = o.schema_id where s.name = ? and o.type in (?, ?) and o.is_ms_shipped = 0 and (cast(? as nvarchar(256)) is null or o.name collate latin1_general_bin2 > cast(? as nvarchar(256)) collate latin1_general_bin2) order by o.name collate latin1_general_bin2

select top (?) o.name as name, o.type as obj_type, cast((select top 1 ep.value from sys.extended_properties ep where ep.class = 1 and ep.major_id = o.object_id and ep.minor_id = 0 and ep.name = ?) as nvarchar(4000)) as comment, case when o.type = ? then (select sum(p.rows) from sys.partitions p where p.object_id = o.object_id and p.index_id < 2) end as row_count from sys.objects o join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = o.schema_id where s.name = ? and o.type in (?, ?) and o.is_ms_shipped = 0 and (cast(? as nvarchar(256)) is null or o.name collate latin1_general_bin2 > cast(? as nvarchar(256)) collate latin1_general_bin2) order by o.name collate latin1_general_bin2

select top (?) o.name as name, o.type as obj_type, cast((select top 1 ep.value from sys.extended_properties ep where ep.class = 1 and ep.major_id = o.object_id and ep.minor_id = 0 and ep.name = ?) as nvarchar(4000)) as comment, case when o.type = ? then (select sum(p.rows) from sys.partitions p where p.object_id = o.object_id and p.index_id < 2) end as row_count from sys.objects o join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = o.schema_id where s.name = ? and o.type in (?, ?) and o.is_ms_shipped = 0 and (cast(? as nvarchar(256)) is null or o.name collate latin1_general_bin2 > cast(? as nvarchar(256)) collate latin1_general_bin2) order by o.name collate latin1_general_bin2

select s.name as schema_name, o.name as table_name, o.type as obj_type, c.column_id as ordinal, c.name as column_name, ty.name as type_name, ty.is_user_defined as is_user_defined, bt.name as base_name, c.max_length as max_length, c.precision as prec, c.scale as scale, c.is_nullable as is_nullable, dc.definition as column_default, cast((select top 1 ep.value from sys.extended_properties ep where ep.class = 1 and ep.major_id = o.object_id and ep.minor_id = c.column_id and ep.name = ?) as nvarchar(4000)) as comment from sys.columns c join sys.objects o on o.object_id = c.object_id join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = o.schema_id join sys.types ty on ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id left join sys.types bt on bt.user_type_id = ty.system_type_id left join sys.default_constraints dc on dc.parent_object_id = c.object_id and dc.parent_column_id = c.column_id where o.type in (?, ?) and ((s.name = ? and o.name = ?) or (s.name = ? and o.name = ?) or (s.name = ? and o.name = ?) or (s.name = ? and o.name = ?) or (s.name = ? and o.name = ?) or (s.name = ? and o.name = ?)) order by s.name, o.name, c.column_id

select s.name as schema_name, o.name as table_name, kc.type as ctype, kc.name as cname, ic.key_ordinal as pos, c.name as column_name, case when cast(serverproperty(?) as int) = 6 then 0 else 1 end as enforced from sys.key_constraints kc join sys.objects o on o.object_id = kc.parent_object_id join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = o.schema_id join sys.index_columns ic on ic.object_id = kc.parent_object_id and ic.index_id = kc.unique_index_id and ic.is_included_column = 0 join sys.columns c on c.object_id = ic.object_id and c.column_id = ic.column_id where kc.type in (?, ?) and ((s.name = ? and o.name = ?) or (s.name = ? and o.name = ?) or (s.name = ? and o.name = ?) or (s.name = ? and o.name = ?) or (s.name = ? and o.name = ?) or (s.name = ? and o.name = ?)) order by s.name, o.name, kc.type desc, kc.name, ic.key_ordinal

select s.name as schema_name, o.name as table_name, fk.name as cname, fkc.constraint_column_id as pos, pc.name as column_name, rs.name as ref_schema, ro.name as ref_table, rc.name as ref_column, case when fk.is_disabled = 1 then 0 else case when cast(serverproperty(?) as int) = 6 then 0 else 1 end end as enforced from sys.foreign_keys fk join sys.objects o on o.object_id = fk.parent_object_id join sys.schemas s on s.schema_id = o.schema_id join sys.foreign_key_columns fkc on fkc.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id join sys.columns pc on pc.object_id = fkc.parent_object_id and pc.column_id = fkc.parent_column_id join sys.objects ro on ro.object_id = fkc.referenced_object_id join sys.schemas rs on rs.schema_id = ro.schema_id join sys.columns rc on rc.object_id = fkc.referenced_object_id and rc.column_id = fkc.referenced_column_id where ((s.name = ? and o.name = ?) or (s.name = ? and o.name = ?) or (s.name = ? and o.name = ?) or (s.name = ? and o.name = ?) or (s.name = ? and o.name = ?) or (s.name = ? and o.name = ?)) order by s.name, o.name, fk.name, fkc.constraint_column_id
